name: black-hole
description: 工作台与组织架构 · 内网管理系统

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
